summary.text: Shawn Kaeser is the Republican candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Crystal Lett is also running.
A social studies teacher with Dublin City Schools since 1995, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his campaign priorities are education, tax reform and affordability.

paragraphs.text: Shawn Kaeser earned a bachelor's degree and a master's degree in education from Wright State University, a master's degree in ministry from Grace College, and a master's degree in social science from Ohio University.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has been a secondary social studies teacher for Dublin City Schools since 1995 and has lived in the Dublin community for more than three decades.
He said he and his wife, who also teaches in Dublin City Schools, have nine children.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
Kaeser listed education, tax reform and affordability as his three key campaign messages, and he reported an endorsement from the Ohio GOP.
